note: Baraga County publishes no queryable zoning district service. County equalization and GIS (colligogis.com/public viewer) expose no zoning layer. Baraga Township zoning is published only as PDF maps and ordinance text (baragatownship.org/zoning/). Village of L'Anse zoning is a PDF map (cms2.revize.com) and ordinance text. ArcGIS Online and Hub searches for Baraga zoning returned no zoning services. WUPPDR says zoning data is available only on request (Steve Rouser).
